_comment: Held-out ground truth for the cerebellum blind reconstruction. Derived from the committed curator-reviewed graphs kb/graphs/cerebellum/CB_MLI_types.yaml and CB_PLI_types.yaml (curator: dosumis, 2026-02-25). Sealed copy of those graphs is in the session scratchpad cerebellum_answer_key/. The blind pipeline must NOT see these files. Recovery = blind-run top candidate matches the target accession at the stated rank. Cross-cutting / distributed cases are expected biology-hard, not system misses.

targets.name: Cerebellar basket cell
targets.note: Basket morphology is a positional subset of transcriptomic MLI1 (5188); MLI1/MLI2 cross-cut the basket/stellate boundary. AT F1 for MLI1->5188 = 0.999.

targets.name: Cerebellar stellate cell
targets.note: Distributed across BOTH MLI1 (5188) and MLI2 (5192) by location; no clean single target by design. Recovery = top candidate in either target set.

targets.name: Candelabrum cell
targets.note: PLI1=Candelabrum -> cluster 5178, AT F1=0.942 at cluster level.

targets.name: Globular cell
targets.note: PLI2=Globular -> cluster 5177 (F1=0.877) but distributes across PLI Gly-Gaba subclass; closeMatch.

targets.name: Lugaro cell
targets.note: PLI3=Lugaro maps cleanly at SUPERTYPE 1145 (F1=0.958); cluster-level is distributed across 5180-5182 (best 5180 F1=0.654). Score primarily at supertype rank.
